name: glycoprotein nmb

function.text: GPNMB encodes transmembrane glycoprotein NMB. Annotated molecular activities include chemoattractant activity and receptor ligand activity. It participates in signal transduction and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to amyloidosis, primary localized cutaneous, 3 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
